metadata.coverage: Partial bounded OSM place query; not a complete neighborhood inventory or a municipal boundary source.
limitations: Source-mapped OSM place polygons are not verified official or legal neighborhood boundaries.
Point-only named places remain points; no polygon is inferred.
The catalog is a partial OSM-derived database and is distributed under ODbL-1.0.

query_bounds_source.display_name: Iași, Iași Metropolitan Area, Iași, Romania
query_bounds_source.note: The city-relation bounding box only bounded the OSM place query; it is not used as a neighborhood boundary.

metadata.reproduction_note: The stored catalog is a normalized derivative of the bounded query and can be loaded with sim.load_neighborhood_catalog(path). The original Overpass response remains in the ignored local demo cache; re-querying the recorded bounds/tags can produce a different snapshot.
